features.name: XxHash64
features.description: Hashes a 4 KiB buffer with one call to the library xxHash64 function.

features.name: XxHash32
features.description: Hashes a 4 KiB buffer with one call to the library xxHash32 function.

features.name: XxHash3
features.description: Hashes a 4 KiB buffer with one call to the library xxHash3 function, sixty-four bits wide.

features.name: XxHash64 Streaming
features.description: Hashes a 4 KiB buffer as sixty-four incremental updates of sixty-four bytes each.

features.name: XxHash64 Large
features.description: Hashes a 1 MiB buffer with one call to the library xxHash64 function, where throughput rather than call overhead dominates.

features.name: Crc32
features.description: Computes the CRC-32 (IEEE) checksum of a 4 KiB buffer with one call.

features.name: Blake3
features.description: Hashes a 4 KiB buffer with BLAKE3 and returns the eight leading digest bytes.
features.reason: With this few rated entrants, the reference is a library's own result, not a result earned against a competitor, so the full 200 points would not reflect a win.

features.name: Blake2b
features.description: Hashes a 4 KiB buffer with BLAKE2b at a 32-byte digest and returns the eight leading digest bytes.
features.reason: With this few rated entrants, the reference is a library's own result, not a result earned against a competitor, so the full 200 points would not reflect a win.

features.description: Hashes a 4 KiB buffer with one call to the library FarmHash64 function.
